description: Registry-owned accept/reject fixtures for the contract `ai` admission rules (spec 001 FR-017, spec 026). Each fixture is evaluated on a minimal contract carrying only the fixture's `ai` value (no `ai` key when the fixture has none). `existing` runs only the whole-tree ai check; `newly_added` also runs the new-contract forward gates (object shape, spec 026 rights). `contract_decidable` fixtures assume every ci_only check passes: no network fetch, and every declared derivation.converted_sha256 is listed in model-weights.json. `ci_only` fixtures supply that context in `ci_context`. Cross-contract rights drift is not modelled. `expect_codes` is the sorted set of distinct CI error codes; `expect` is `accept` exactly when it is empty. Downstream: traverse-cli `capability publish` must agree with every `contract_decidable` + `newly_added` fixture (traverse Spec 056 v1.1.0 FR-019). SPDX ids resolve against scripts/ci/fixtures/spdx_symbols.json, the pinned license-expression symbol table (licenses and exceptions, keys and aliases, matched case-insensitively).
